title: US retail store closures tracked per year

source.name: US Store Tracker — retail store openings and closures

notes: Coresight Research tracks major-retailer store closures announced in the US. 2023: 4,913 stores closed. 2024: 7,327 stores closed, reported by trade press (e.g. chaindrugreview.com, credaily.com) as roughly 58% higher than 2023 -- the two independently reported totals imply a slightly different percentage (about 49%), a normal discrepancy between preliminary and revised tracker counts; both raw counts are reported directly by Coresight and are used here as-is.
